primary_rate_method: discrete potential-surcharge classification at HTSUS10 on calendar day 15; direct civil aircraft are classified at 0 subject to General Note 6, other use-conditioned lines default to the full headline rate, and content-dependent measures use the highest potentially applicable statutory rate with an up_to qualifier
yale_auxiliary_fields: yale_modeled_rate_reference and Yale day-weighted/end-of-month fields preserve the source model for audit only; they do not determine dashboard bands
